Purpose: Invisible StandardForm and TraditionalForm PowerLogSeries display with complete interpretation, reconstructible InputForm, and ordinary remainder-free Normal results
ValidationScope: Thirteen explicitly selected formatting tests cover full-object roundtrips in two presentation forms, complete InputForm text and box serialization, visible precedence independent of hidden interpretation, Normal, multiple remainder scales, and held-input non-evaluation. No full package suite was run.
NormalContract: Normal[PowerLogSeries[a]] returns a["Expression"]. It contains neither the PowerLogSeries wrapper nor the displayed remainder; a pure-remainder result returns zero. The existing Normal implementation was preserved and verified.
ImplementationReview: Independent static review checked held association-rule extraction, literal-only remainder-scale simplifications, preservation of hidden interpretation payloads, readonly boxes, and InputForm scope. Native tests and rendering checked contextual precedence. Held outer Plus terms are flattened syntactically without evaluating coefficients.

Checks: No visible wrapper in series outputs
No redundant grouping around finite sums
Correct grouping under powers, products, and reciprocals
NativeVisualReview.EnvironmentMessage: RegisterFormat::interr reported ImageMetadataTools could not be installed. Rasterize returned an Image and PNG export succeeded; the exported image was visually inspected.

MathematicalArticle.Scope: Display behavior does not change the mathematics. No new article build or render was required.
